orders: create table sales.accounts(tenant_id bigint,id bigint,enabled boolean not null,primary key(tenant_id,id))

create table sales.orders(tenant_id bigint,id bigint,account_id bigint,status text,amount numeric(20,6),primary key(tenant_id,id),foreign key(tenant_id,account_id) references sales.accounts(tenant_id,id))
billing: create table risk.accounts(tenant_id bigint,id bigint,status text,credit_limit numeric(20,6),primary key(tenant_id,id))
create table pay.payments(tenant_id bigint,order_id bigint,status text,amount numeric(20,6),primary key(tenant_id,order_id))
